title: Deliverable 617319: Move French accelerated depreciation to W1 base application
summary: French accelerated depreciation functionality is now part of the standard W1 base application, with migration support for existing French setups through feature management.
key_points: Derogatory depreciation moved from French-specific localization to the core application
New depreciation book setup fields, posting accounts, and calculation logic added to all installations
Links created between regular and derogatory entries to maintain consistency during posting and reversals
Feature management controls migration of existing French depreciation books and historical data
Reports and layouts updated to display derogatory depreciation information
quote: Moved derogatory depreciation from FR BaseApp to W1 BaseApp.
